description.value: Fairfield Bicycle Shop LTD. is a Victoria institution with over 30 years of history, known as Vancouver Island's original e-bike store and a go-to destination for trikes, cargo bikes, and hard-to-find parts that stump other shops. The repair department has grown to six benches staffed by technicians with a claimed 200+ years of collective experience, offering everything from flat fixes to full overhauls, custom builds, wheel building, and e-kit installs. Touring cyclists will find a shop oriented toward practical, everyday riding with an 'Adventure & Touring' bike category and a broad accessories range including bags, racks, fenders, and lights.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for fairfieldbicycle.com is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone 250-381-2453, address 390 Moss Street, Victoria). The website establishes a full-service repair operation with explicitly listed repair categories including e-bike services, plus an 'Adventure & Touring' bike category and touring accessories inventory; however, no explicit mention of a pump, walk-in policy, bike rentals, washrooms, or most other amenities was found. One notable name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Fairfield Bicycle Shop' while the website consistently uses 'Fairfield Bicycle Shop LTD.'
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records 'Fairfield Bicycle Shop' but the website consistently uses 'Fairfield Bicycle Shop LTD.' — OSM name may be missing the legal suffix.
Internal inconsistency on website: the front page states the repair shop 'expanded to 6 benches' while the services subpage says 'four workbenches' — content appears out of sync between pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established full-service bike shop with repair expertise, e-bike services, and touring-oriented stock — a clear and valuable resource for cyclists passing through Victoria.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Website lists an 'Adventure & Touring' category under Bikes, and stocks touring-relevant accessories including bags, racks, lights, fenders, and pumps; front page notes the shop is 'a remarkable source for hard to find parts.'

E-bike service.detail: Services page lists eBike Full Tune, eCargo and eTandem Tune, eTrike Tune, eBike Overhaul, eCargo/eTandem Overhaul, eTrike Overhaul, E-Kit Install, and eBike Parts; billed as 'Vancouver Island's Original E-Bike Store.'

wow_evidence: Victoria institution with over 30 years of history... Adventure & Touring bike category
